ov: بيكي بلايندرز: الرجل الخالد (الإنجليزية: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man) هو فلم دراما جريمة ملحمي صدر عام 2026، من إخراج توم هاربر وسيناريو ستيفن نايت. وهو تكملة للمسلسل البريطاني بيكي بلايندرز (2013-2022)، ويشارك في بطولته كيليان مورفي إلى جانب طاقم تمثيل يضم ستيفن غراهام، ونيد دينيهي، وباكي لي، وإيان بيك، وريبيكا فيرغسون، وتيم روث، وجاي ليكورجو، وباري كيوغان. صدر الفلم في دور عرض مختارة في 6 مارس 2026، وعلى منصة نتفليكس في 20 مارس 2026.
plotEn:
In November 1940, former Member of Parliament Tommy Shelby is writing an autobiography after retreating from public life following the death of his elder brother Arthur. Ada Shelby, who has succeeded Tommy as the MP for Birmingham South, keeps him informed about his son Duke, the leader of the Peaky Blinders crime gang. The Birmingham Blitz is in full swing, and a Luftwaffe night raid on Birmingham destroys a BSA munitions factory. The gang steals munitions from the destroyed factory, unaware Duke has privately joined forces with Nazi agent John Beckett, who intends to have the Peaky Blinders distribute £70 million of counterfeit currency through the gang's networks so Nazi Germany can subdue the United Kingdom's economy by hyperinflation.
Kaulo Chiriklo, the twin sister of Duke's mother Zelda Chiriklo, calls Tommy the Rom Baro (Gypsy King), claims to have spoken to Arthur beyond the grave, and goads Tommy into divulging he'd accidentally killed Arthur, who had acted erratically under the influence of opium. She interprets Tommy's act as a kindness, and convinces him to return to Birmingham to help Duke. Beckett discovers Ada has evidence of Duke's involvement in the factory raid and intends to share it with authorities and derail the plot. When Duke proves unable to follow Beckett's orders to kill Ada, Beckett kills her himself.
